html:
Email Integration Website $7500

Yes, you can get a full‑featured website that includes email and form integrations for $7,500. On this page you’ll see what the Signature service includes and how to start the project.

How it works for a business that needs email capture and automated forms

  1. Free homepage remake – request a redesign of your current homepage; no call, no payment details. If you don’t like the result you keep the design.
  2. Sign the contract – pay a 50 % deposit. The remaining balance is due at launch.
  3. Launch – within about a week we deliver a custom site with unlimited sections, galleries, an admin panel, spreadsheet‑based events, and the email/form integrations you asked for.
  4. 90 days of free care – we monitor the site, fix bugs, and answer questions at no charge. After that you can keep the site with an optional care plan or simply own it outright.

What you get and the cost

  • Signature website design – $7,500 total (one‑time fee).
  • Unlimited page sections, photo galleries, and a custom admin panel.
  • Email and form integrations that push submissions to your inbox or spreadsheets.
  • All code, content, and domain remain yours; you own the site outright.
  • Hosting is $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • 90 days of free post‑launch care; optional ongoing care at $295 / month or $595 / month, cancel any time.

FAQ

What is included in the $7,500 price? The Signature package covers unlimited site sections, galleries, an admin panel, spreadsheet‑based events, and full email/form integrations. It also includes custom design work and a week‑long development timeline.

Do I have to pay ongoing hosting fees? No. Hosting is provided at $0/month through Cloudflare Pages and GitHub. You only pay if you choose a care plan after the free 90‑day period.

Can I see an example of a similar project? Yes. The US250 Tour case study used the $7,500 package, handling 2,100+ photos, 78 GB of assets, and zero downtime. View it at us250tour.com case study.

What if I need a website faster than a week? The standard launch timeline is about a week. Faster delivery would require a separate agreement and pricing.

How do I start?
